_schema.purpose: Pin the hashcash token format and SHA-256 mining loop. One vector per (method, path) pair the relay accepts so `requestPathHash` derivation is locked.

format.vectors[].name: Human label.
format.vectors[].inputs.path: URL path; uses :roomId style placeholders before substitution. The hash is over (method || ' ' || path) of the ACTUAL request path (substituted), see `inputs.pathSubstituted`.
format.vectors[].inputs.pathSubstituted: Path with parameters filled in — this is what gets fed to SHA-256.
format.vectors[].inputs.roomId: Room ID string used in the `resource` field.
format.vectors[].inputs.deviceId: Device ID string used in the `resource` field.
format.vectors[].inputs.rand: base64url-no-pad of 16 random bytes; the per-token nonce.
format.vectors[].expected.requestPathHash: base64url-no-pad of first 8 bytes of SHA-256(method || ' ' || pathSubstituted).
format.vectors[].expected.resource: Concatenated `<roomId>:<deviceId>:<requestPathHash>` exactly as it appears in the token.
format.vectors[].expected.counter: Decimal integer (as a string for >2^53 safety) — the smallest non-negative counter producing a valid hash.
format.vectors[].expected.tokenHashHex: lowercase hex of SHA-256(token) — convenient for debugging leading-zero-bit checks.
format.vectors[].expected.token: The full token string `attn-pow:v2:...:<counter>` that meets the difficulty.
